blur.$description: Theme-independent blur roles for lightweight visual fragments.

progressive.$description: Increasing blur stages used together to create a smooth directional backdrop blur.

backgroundMaterial.$description: Backdrop blur roles for translucent background materials. All roles intentionally alias the same 15px primitive; their paired colour tint expresses thickness.

ultraThin.$description: Shared material blur paired with the lightest tint contribution.

thin.$description: Light separation for bars, edge treatments, and compact chrome.

regular.$description: Default material separation for panels and floating controls.

thick.$description: Strong separation for sheets and content-bearing overlays.

ultraThick.$description: Shared material blur paired with the strongest tint contribution.

menu.$description: Backdrop blur for compact menu and submenu surfaces.
